allow_large: The owner set the AGENTS.md-only rule on 2026-10-01; two source files change and four existing tests that pinned the old CLAUDE.md behaviour must change with them
done_when: forge sync (and so init, adopt, migrate and upgrade) leaves no CLAUDE.md at the repo root: lines of CLAUDE.md that AGENTS.md doesn't already have are moved into AGENTS.md outside Forge's block, in their order, then CLAUDE.md is deleted; an @AGENTS.md import line and Forge's old block are dropped, never moved. Claude Code reads AGENTS.md itself when there is no CLAUDE.md. The skill and the guide say a repo keeps its rules in AGENTS.md only. Command-level tests: a CLAUDE.md with its own lines (moved, then deleted), one whose lines are already in AGENTS.md (deleted), and a second sync changes nothing.

findings.body: With an in-repo AGENTS.md symlink and a repo-owned `.claude/agents/tester.md`, this loop replaces the symlink before `roles.refuse_foreign` rejects the sync at line 352. The command therefore fails but leaves AGENTS.md changed into a regular file. `src/forge/roles.py:103` promises refusal before writes, and `tests/test_subagent_roles.py:128` checks that refusal leaves the working tree untouched; its fixture lacks a symlink and misses this case. Compute and validate the planned output before unlinking or materializing either rules file.
findings.title: Validate sync output before replacing symlinks

why: The owner wants no CLAUDE.md at all in repos Forge runs, only AGENTS.md, but forge sync keeps a CLAUDE.md that has lines of its own and adds an @AGENTS.md import to it
